title.en: Barrier and seed: effective Cu is narrower than the trench

subtitle.zh: 连续性、覆盖率与导体面积必须同时考虑
subtitle.en: Consider continuity, coverage and conductor area together

body.zh: 沟槽定义外边界，Barrier / Seed进一步定义有效Cu Core
body.en: Trench defines the outer boundary; barrier / seed further define the effective Cu core

body.zh: 下游影响：Cu扩散、填充完整性、电阻与电迁移可靠性
body.en: Downstream: Cu diffusion, fill integrity, resistance and electromigration reliability

body.zh: 边界：Barrier、Liner、Seed材料与沉积方式会随节点和金属体系变化。
body.en: Scope: barrier, liner, seed materials and deposition vary with node and metal system
